title: Areed's CoreLib
description: The Base Library/Abstraction Layer for my own mods in order to make maintainance easier.
body:
The base Library for a lot of my other fabric mods. If you are a player who needs this for one of my mods, download the version you need depending on your game version (preferably the latest) This Library mostly acts as an abstraction layer between MC and my mods, in simple words, it makes it easy to update all the mods to latest version :} --- `Note: this lib and my other projects are ARR (All rights reserved) because as a starter from bedrock addons on curseforge, thats what im comfortable with lol. But that doesn't mean you cannot see the source, if you want to check out the source code, just ping me in my discord server, and if i ever stop maintaining any of my projects, I will 100% open source them :]`
 

If you want to support me and donate a small amount, please consider this one time patreon donation (no subscription or membership)
